SYNTHETIC TRAINING NOTE - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
Robotic Bronchoscopy Procedure Report
Procedure date: 2026-03-23

**Indication:** Patient: 72-year-old female, former smoker (10 pack-years). Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion.

**Anesthesia:** ASA class IV. Moderate sedation was used with a natural airway.

**Procedures:** Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed. Linear EBUS staging was planned but was not started and was not performed (deferred).

## Robotic navigation and sampling
The Ion robotic platform was used for navigation. The Ion robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a lesion in the right middle lobe. There was no bronchus sign. It was not FDG-avid on PET. The robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed a concentric view, confirming tool-in-lesion. Fluoroscopy was used during sampling. Transbronchial needle aspiration was performed with a 19-gauge needle (3 passes). Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (3 passes). ROSE of target 1 showed atypical cells; the sample was adequate. Specimen B: forceps biopsies from target 1 (histology). Target 2 was a 16 mm solid lesion in the inferior lingular segment (LB5) of the lingula. Target 2 was the prespecified biopsy target. The robotic catheter was navigated to target 2, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed a concentric view, confirming tool-in-lesion. Transbronchial needle aspiration was performed with a 25-gauge needle (4 passes). Bronchial brushings were obtained (one passes). Specimen C: needle aspirates and brushings from target 2 (cytology).

**Complications:** No immediate complications.

**Disposition:** Procedure duration: 113 minutes.

Robotic Bronchoscopy Procedure Report
Procedure date: 2026-02-08

**Indication:** Patient: 60-year-old male. Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion.

**Anesthesia:** General anesthesia via an 8.5 mm endotracheal tube.

**Procedures:** Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed.

## Robotic navigation and sampling
The Galaxy robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a 3.5 cm lesion in the right middle lobe. A bronchus sign was present. Target 1 was the prespecified biopsy target. The robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Mobile cone-beam CT confirmed the needle tip within the lesion before sampling (tool-in-lesion). Fluoroscopy was used during sampling. Transbronchial cryobiopsy was performed with a 1.1 mm cryoprobe (2 passes). ROSE of target 1 showed benign bronchial cells and macrophages; the sample was adequate. Specimen A: cryobiopsies from target 1 (histology).

**Complications:** No immediate complications.

**Disposition:** Procedure duration: 90 minutes. The patient was discharged home after recovery.

Robotic Bronchoscopy Procedure Report
Procedure date: 2026-09-13

**Indication:** The patient is a 57-year-old male, former smoker (20 pack-years). Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion and mediastinal staging.

**Anesthesia:** ASA class III. General anesthesia via a 7.5 mm endotracheal tube.

**Procedures:** Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed. Linear EBUS-TBNA was performed as planned and completed.

## Robotic navigation and sampling
The Ion robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a 26 mm lesion in the lateral basal segment (RB9) of the right lower lobe. A bronchus sign was present. It was FDG-avid (SUVmax 4.6). The robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed a concentric view. Fixed cone-beam CT confirmed the needle tip within the lesion before sampling (tool-in-lesion). Transbronchial needle aspiration was performed with a 21-gauge needle (two passes). Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (six passes). Transbronchial cryobiopsy was performed with a 1.7 mm cryoprobe (seven passes). Bronchial brushings were obtained (one passes). ROSE of target 1 showed malignant cells consistent with non-small cell carcinoma; the sample was adequate. Target 2 was a 18 mm lesion in the right upper lobe. A bronchus sign was present. It was FDG-avid (SUVmax 10.9). The robotic catheter was navigated to target 2, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed an eccentric view. Cone-beam CT showed the catheter touching the lesion. Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (four passes). ROSE of target 2 showed scant cellularity, nondiagnostic; the sample was not adequate. Specimen C: forceps biopsies from target 2 (histology).

## Linear EBUS
Linear EBUS was performed for mediastinal restaging using a systematic sampling strategy. The systematic nodal examination was complete. Station 4L was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 4L: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, three passes. ROSE of station 4L: non-necrotizing granulomas, adequate. Station 7 was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 7 measured 7 mm in short axis. Station 7: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 22-gauge needle, 3 passes. ROSE of station 7: blood only, inadequate. Specimen D: station 7 aspirates (cytology). Station 11Rs was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 11Rs measured 11 mm in short axis. Station 11Rs: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 25-gauge needle, two passes.

**Complications:** No immediate complications.

**Disposition:** The patient was discharged home after recovery.

The patient is an 81-year-old female. Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion and mediastinal staging.

Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed. Linear EBUS-TBNA was performed as planned and completed.

The Monarch robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a 9 mm lesion in the left lower lobe. A bronchus sign was present. Target 1 was the prespecified biopsy target. The first navigation attempt to target 1 did not reach the target because persistent airway bleeding obscured the pathway. On the second attempt, the robotic catheter was navigated to target 1, and the target was reached and sampled. Radial EBUS showed a concentric view. Mobile cone-beam CT confirmed the needle tip within the lesion before sampling (tool-in-lesion). Fluoroscopy was used during sampling. Transbronchial needle aspiration was performed with a 25-gauge needle (5 passes). Transbronchial forceps biopsies were obtained (6 passes). Bronchial brushings were obtained (1 passes). ROSE of target 1 showed malignant cells consistent with non-small cell carcinoma; the sample was adequate. Specimen B: forceps biopsies from target 1 (histology).

Linear EBUS was performed for initial mediastinal staging using a systematic sampling strategy. The systematic nodal examination was complete. Station 2R was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 2R: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 21-gauge needle, 5 passes. Specimen C: station 2R aspirates (cytology). Station 2L was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 2L: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 21-gauge needle, 4 passes. ROSE of station 2L: malignant cells, adequate. Station 11Rs was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 11Rs: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 25-gauge needle, five passes. ROSE of station 11Rs: blood only, inadequate. Specimen D: station 11Rs aspirates (cytology). Station 11R was visualized on EBUS and sampled. Station 11R measured 21 mm in short axis. Station 11R: EBUS-guided TBNA with a 21-gauge needle, 5 passes. ROSE of station 11R: blood only, inadequate. Specimen E: station 11R aspirates (cytology). Station 11L was visualized on EBUS but not sampled because it appeared benign on ultrasound. Station 11L measured 7 mm in short axis.

No immediate complications. There was no pneumothorax and no significant bleeding.

The patient was discharged home after recovery.

The patient is a 73-year-old male, never smoker. Indication: tissue diagnosis of a peripheral lung lesion and mediastinal staging.

PROCEDURES
Robotic-assisted bronchoscopy was performed as planned and completed. Linear EBUS-TBNA was performed as planned and completed.

The Monarch robotic platform was used for navigation. Target 1 was a 11 mm lesion in the inferior lingular segment (LB5) of the lingula. There was no bronchus sign.
